about: Waits the method's wording cannot settle on its own, each reviewed by a person. min and max are the unattended minutes the recipe takes beyond prep and cook. src/lib/timing.js uses these in place of what it reads from the method; tools/timing-audit.js lists them.

brisket.reason: "Close the lid and leave it alone for 3 hours" is smoking time, already in the cook time; the wait counted is the rest of at least 2 hours (ideally 4, not counted as the ceiling because the method treats it as an ideal). The hour the seasoned brisket sits at room temperature before smoking is not counted; whether the prep time allows for it is open for review.
